@dataclass
class User:
    """Represents an application user with login and item-ownership state.

    Attributes:
        id: Unique integer identifier for the user.
        email: Email address used to identify and authenticate the user.
        name: Human-readable display name.
        active: Whether the account is enabled. Defaults to ``True``.
        item_ids: List of item identifiers owned by this user. Defaults to an
            empty list.

    Methods:
        can_login: Return ``True`` when the user is active and the email
            address contains an ``@`` character.
        owns_item: Return ``True`` when the given ``item_id`` is present in
            ``item_ids``.

    Example:
        >>> user = User(id=1, email="alice@example.com", name="Alice")
        >>> user.can_login()
        True
        >>> user.item_ids.append(42)
        >>> user.owns_item(42)
        True
        >>> user.owns_item(7)
        False
    """

    id: int
    email: str
    name: str
    active: bool = True
    item_ids: list[int] = field(default_factory=list)

    def can_login(self) -> bool:
        return self.active and "@" in self.email

    def owns_item(self, item_id: int) -> bool:
        return item_id in self.item_ids

- One-line summary.
